channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says the gate house was demolished, "one of five buildings removed from the lot". DataSF, permit 202007200487: "description":"bldg# 12-to demolish a type 3b, 1-story currently unoccupied bldg.(total 5 bldgs to be demolished on this lot, this bldg named as station a gate house on the dwgs)","status":"complete","completed_date":"2021-05-10". The permit shows this one building done (permit complete, 2021-05-10); the five is a planned count from the description, and no permit read shows the other four removed. The earlier row is left as written.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Station A (Block 15): the October 22, 2020 Planning Commission action is now described as the office allocation (Motion 20801) and a loading Major Modification (Resolution 20802), with the adaptive-reuse design approved by the Planning Director on March 2, 2022, in the record, the map notes and the timeline. The 2024 annual compliance report is now described as reporting brick stabilization work on Station A but no adaptive-reuse construction. The unsupported '11-story' count and the 16,225 sq ft terrace figure were removed, the 2018 Draft EIR now backs the 65 ft and 1901-02 statements, and the map caveat no longer calls this existing building vacant land. A citation to the Planning Commission's website home page, standing in for the minutes, was replaced with the design-review memo, the Chronicle title and Meyers+ date were corrected, and the D4D publisher is shown as SF Planning.
item.description: Station A (Block 15): the October 22, 2020 Planning Commission action is now described as the office allocation (Motion 20801) and a loading Major Modification (Resolution 20802), with the adaptive-reuse design approved by the Planning Director on March 2, 2022, in the record, the map notes and the timeline. The 2024 annual compliance report is now described as reporting brick stabilization work on Station A but no adaptive-reuse construction. The unsupported '11-story' count and the 16,225 sq ft terrace figure were removed, the 2018 Draft EIR now backs the 65 ft and 1901-02 statements, and the map caveat no longer calls this existing building vacant land. A citation to the Planning Commission's website home page, standing in for the minutes, was replaced with the design-review memo, the Chronicle title and Meyers+ date were corrected, and the D4D publisher is shown as SF Planning. item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Station A built in 1901-02, with a 1930-31 addition (Draft EIR Table 4.D-1: 'Construction Date 1901-02; 1930-31'), predating the Potrero Power Station redevelopment plan by more than a century; the building has not been demolished, and the March 2, 2022 design review approval plans its adaptive reuse as an office building ('All of the Station A walls are retained') (Sep 29, 2026)

item.title: Milestone · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: Developer (Fifth Space) requests a Development Agreement amendment to increase Station A's permitted height by 30 feet, among other changes, to make its 'smaller floorplate' more attractive to commercial tenants; the Planning Commission considered the request that week (Chronicle, July 29, 2026) and approved the amendment unanimously, sending it to the Board of Supervisors (SF Standard, August 3, 2026); the Board of Supervisors then passed the amendment package on first reading on Sept 29, 2026 (see the next entry) (~2026)
